info.title: Electron Hub API
info.description: Unified API platform integrating 200+ AI models for chat, image generation, speech-to-text, embeddings, and more.

get.description: List all available models

post.description: Create a chat completion using OpenAI format. Reasoning models stream their thoughts in a separate `reasoning` field by default; see `/v1legacy/chat/completions` and `/v1thinking/chat/completions` for alternative shapes.

Same request/response shape as `/v1/chat/completions`, but reasoning output is delivered in the legacy `reasoning_content` field instead of `reasoning`. Use this for clients that only understand `reasoning_content` (e.g. older DeepSeek SDKs).
Same request/response shape as `/v1/chat/completions`, but the model's reasoning is merged into the normal `content` stream wrapped in `<think>...</think>` tags instead of a separate field.
Create a message using the Anthropic Messages API shape.
Create a response using OpenAI's new response format
Generate images from text prompts
Edit images with prompts
Generate videos from text prompts (SSE streaming)

200.description: SSE stream of video generation events

post.description: Create text embeddings
Check content for moderation

Ask a decision model structured questions about `state`. The model is `jev` ($0.042 / 1M input). Output tokens are free. `state` is text or JSON. Image parts and data-URL images are rejected. `POST /decisions` is an alias. Unknown body fields are ignored.

get.description: Model, context length, question types, and pricing for the decisions endpoint.

Retrieve a per-model cost and usage breakdown for the authenticated user, including request counts, token usage, total cost, and provider information for every model used.
Get recent API request logs for the authenticated user
Get all proxy keys for the authenticated user

get.description: How Auto ranks models for a category, cost tier, and difficulty: quality, estimated cost, the selected model, and its fallbacks. Pass `category=all` (or a comma-separated list) to rank every task in one call; the Auto panel should use that instead of 14 parallel requests.

error.message: Unknown category 'nope'. Use all, or: chat, coding, reasoning, math, science, creative, vision, long_context, agentic, factuality, safety, roleplay, summarization, translation

error.message: Only master keys can manage Router settings.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: One of chat, coding, reasoning, math, science, creative, vision, long_context, agentic, factuality, safety, roleplay, summarization, translation; a comma-separated subset; repeated `category` parameters; or `all`. Case is ignored. `all` cannot be combined with other categories. One category returns a flat object. Two or more return `picks` and `categories`.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Professional domain, e.g. legal, medical, finance.

parameters.name: frontier
parameters.description: When set, each category also includes `frontier_rank` (Pareto mix of quality vs price).

parameters.name: includeItems
parameters.description: Set false to omit per-model `items`. `frontier` still adds `frontier_rank`. Leave true for the Cost vs quality chart.

tokens.description: Context length of the model (maximum combined input and output tokens)

premium_model.description: Whether this is a premium model

sizes.description: Available image sizes for image generation models

qualities.description: Available quality levels for image generation models

tags.description: Available tags for music generation models

styles.description: Available styles for video generation models

metadata.description: Additional metadata for chat completion models

model.description: Model id, or "auto" for the Auto Router. Accepts variants such as :nitro, :floor, :exacto and :<effort>.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort level. Silently ignored for models that do not support reasoning_effort, so clients can send a single shared request across providers.

reasoning.description: Reasoning configuration. Per-request override for reasoning output behavior.

exclude.description: If true, strip the reasoning stream from the response entirely. The model still computes (and is billed for) reasoning tokens.

delta_field.description: Override the streaming/non-streaming field name regardless of which endpoint variant was hit.

reasoning_content_compat.description: Shorthand: set to `true` to force the legacy `reasoning_content` field, equivalent to `reasoning.delta_field = "reasoning_content"`.

models.description: Up to 3 fallback models, tried in order when model cannot serve the request.

session_id.description: Conversation id that keeps the Auto Router on one model across turns.

content.description: May be null in assistant deltas/responses when only reasoning is being emitted.

reasoning.description: (Assistant only) The model's thinking/reasoning output, returned alongside `content` by `/v1/chat/completions`. Omitted when the model does not produce reasoning or when reasoning is excluded.

reasoning_content.description: (Assistant only) Legacy field name for `reasoning`. Populated by `/v1legacy/chat/completions` or when `reasoning_content_compat=true` / `reasoning.delta_field="reasoning_content"` is set.

router_fee.description: Auto Router fee in USD. Present only when a fee applies.

model.description: Model id, or "auto" for the Auto Router. Accepts variants such as :nitro, :floor, :exacto and :<effort>.

reasoning_effort.description: Ignored for models that do not support reasoning_effort

models.description: Up to 3 fallback models, tried in order when model cannot serve the request.

fallbacks.description: Anthropic-style fallback list. Cannot be combined with models.

role.description: Turn role. Mid-conversation system turns are accepted.

type.description: Built-in Anthropic tool type when applicable

model.description: Model id, or "auto" for the Auto Router. Accepts variants such as :nitro, :floor, :exacto and :<effort>.

models.description: Up to 3 fallback models, tried in order when model cannot serve the request.

prompt_cache_key.description: With model "auto", groups requests into one conversation together with the first user message.

prompt.description: Text description of the desired image

public.description: Whether to make the image publicly accessible

prompt.description: A text description of the desired image
Text description of the desired video

dimensions.description: Number of dimensions for the embedding

model.description: `jev`. `jev-latest`, `typesafe/jev`, and `typesafe/jev-latest` are aliases. Version pins are rejected.

state.description: The facts needed to answer. A string, object, or array, including empty. Image parts (image_url, image, input_image) and data-URL images are rejected with param state. Describe the image with a vision model and put that text here.

questions.description: Non-empty map of question IDs to question definitions. IDs must be non-empty and cannot be `__proto__`.

criteria.description: choice (required): object of option ID to description, 1 to 255 options; a description may also be null. score (required): array of level descriptions, lowest first, 1 to 10 levels; an object keyed "0", "1", ... with no gaps is also accepted. noul (optional): object with exactly the keys `true` and `false`. Descriptions may be strings, objects, or arrays.

score.description: score: expected level on the 0-based scale, as a decimal.

legend.description: score: level index to the description sent in `criteria`.

noul.description: noul: probability of yes. Near 0.5 is uncertain.

probabilities.description: choice and score: option ID or level index to probability, rounded to two decimals.

confidence.description: choice and score: certainty signal. Not the largest probability. May be omitted.

total_consumption.description: Total API spend across all models (in credits/USD)

models.description: Map of model IDs to their usage statistics

last_updated.description: ISO timestamp of the last usage update

requests.description: Total number of requests made to this model

total_cost.description: Total cost in credits for this model

requests.description: Number of requests made on this date

ip_whitelist.description: List of allowed IP addresses or CIDR blocks

is_active.description: Whether the proxy key is active

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp in seconds (-1 for no expiration)

model_whitelist.description: List of allowed models (empty for all models)

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp in seconds (-1 for no expiration)

model_whitelist.description: List of allowed models (empty for all models)

ip_whitelist.description: List of allowed IP addresses or CIDR blocks (empty for all IPs)

proxy_key.description: The proxy key to look up / toggle / delete (must be one you own)

key.description: API key used for the request

input_tokens.description: Number of input tokens (for text models)

output_tokens.description: Number of output tokens (for text models)

model.description: The TTS model to use for speech generation

input.description: The text to convert to speech (OpenAI models)
input.example: Hello, world! This is a text-to-speech example.

voice.description: The voice to use for speech generation (OpenAI, Orpheus, PlayAI, ElevenLabs models)

response_format.description: The audio format for the generated speech

speed.description: The speed of the generated audio

temperature.description: Temperature for randomness in speech generation

instructions.description: Additional instructions to control voice generation (GPT-4o Mini TTS)

cfg_filter_top_k.description: CFG filter top k value (Dia model)

speech_rate.description: Speech rate adjustment for Microsoft TTS (-100 to 100)

pitch_adjustment.description: Pitch adjustment for Microsoft TTS (-100 to 100)

file.description: Audio file (flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm). Max 25 MB / 25 minutes.

language.description: ISO-639-1 code, or auto/multi where supported

model_config.description: JSON string of engine-specific options (e.g. Deepgram)

order.description: Provider ids to try first, in this order.

allow_fallbacks.description: false: first-ranked provider only, no retry on another provider.

max_price.description: Ceiling in USD per million tokens.

preferred_min_throughput.description: Prefer providers at or above this many output tokens per second (number = p50).

preferred_max_latency.description: Prefer providers at or below this many seconds to the first token (number = p50).

RouterOptions.description: Auto Router options, used with model "auto". See https://docs.electronhub.ai/routing/auto-router

policy.description: Policy id to use instead of the default.

allowed_models.description: Model patterns Auto may pick from, e.g. anthropic/*.

strict_allowed.description: Fail with 404 when allowed_models match nothing.

classifier.description: rules: built-in rules only, no routing fee.
`rules` skips the routing model and its fee.

shadowPercent.description: Share of requests that also record a comparison against a baseline pick.

activitySampleApi.description: Share of API requests stored in the decision log.

steerManualPicks.description: Electron Hub app: route manual model picks.

scope.description: Electron Hub app surfaces where steering applies.

applyMode.description: Electron Hub app: apply picks directly or preview them first.

preferFast.description: Prefer models with the fastest end-to-end response.

maxTtft.description: Maximum seconds to the first answer token (0 = off).

rules.description: Ordered rules: `when` conditions on request signals, `then` actions.

default.description: Actions when no rule matches. Default `[{"action": "useAuto"}]`.

maxCostPerReq.description: Estimated cost cap per request, in USD.

blockOverCost.description: Block instead of downgrading when over `maxCostPerReq`.

budgetUsd.description: Spend budget per window, in USD.

budgetScope.description: Count Auto requests only, or all spend.

blockOverBudget.description: Block instead of using the cheapest model when the budget is spent.

entities.description: Entity types to detect; empty means all except `name`.

scanAll.description: Scan every message, not only the latest.

semantic.description: Also match similar, not only identical, requests.
